intro: Madagascar is a republic that has faced repeated political crises.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The constitution provides for an elected president and parliament. After the October 2025 crisis, Colonel Michael Randrianirina took power and promised a transition, with elections planned for 2027.

chapters.title: Gen Z protests
text: The 2025 protests began over water and power cuts.
